997-2317-7084-8345.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6458.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4247-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4247-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-728-1796-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4417-4591-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2511-2738-4871-5687.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

443-2946-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2946-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

186-1912-7426-7648.description:
Activate Assassin Den by paying {U} due to Biomancer's Familiar and Heartstone, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1362-1558-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

997-2178-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4613-5310-5477-5627-6791.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6791.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

3497-4907-5231-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4907-5231-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {1} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

6112-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6112-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3967-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
3967-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1170-1329-1492-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4268-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4268-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1529-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
An opponent has eight or fewer poison counters.
1529-5902.description:
Cast Vraska by paying {4}{B}{B}, causing it to enter with at least ten loyalty counters due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Vraska's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing target opponent to get enough poison counters such that they will have at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

101-1987-2187-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-2187-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Possessed Skaab and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-2187-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1636-1719-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1636-1719-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3967-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5344-5869.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

3490-3910-4017-4365-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
3490-3910-4017-4365-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

957-2239-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Ardent Elementalist.
957-2239-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

518-896-5109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
518-896-5109.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting any creature you control.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate General's Regalia by paying {3}, choosing to redirect the next damage Volcano Hellion does to you to the creature targeted by Arcbond instead.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's ability, dealing an arbirarily large amount of damage to the creature targeted by Arcbond.
Arcbond triggers, holding priority,  activate General's Regalia by paying {3}, choosing to redirect the next damage Arcbond does to you to Volcano Hellion instead.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to each creature and each opponent.

1866-2882-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
1866-2882-4050-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sandbar Merfolk, adding {U}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1744-2021-3112.description:
Cast Rite of Replication kicked by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Slurrk.
Put each Slurrk token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Slurrk token triggers four times, the nontoken Slurrk triggers five times, and Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers five times.
Resolve all Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting 25 growth counters on it.
Resolve the first Slurrk trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Simic Ascendacy's first ability triggers for each counter placed this way, putting that many growth counters on it.
Repeat from step 5 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

261-661-5118.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
261-661-5118.notablePrerequisites:
Rescue Racer.
Ratchet is your commander.
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
261-661-5118.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Ratchet, Rescue Racer.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Sculpting Steel triggers, failing to convert it.
Cast Ratchet from the command zone as Ratchet, Field Medic by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain one life.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, converting itself.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6.

1600-2302-4468.notablePrerequisites: The same color chosen with Painter's Servant and Teferi's Moat.
1600-2302-4468.description:
Teferi's Moat prevents creatures of the chosen color without flying from attacking you.
Because Painter's Servant makes all creatures the chosen color, and Mystic Decree causes all creatures to lose flying, no creatures can attack you.

215-307-2792.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature that can attack this turn.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}{U}.
Great Whale does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
215-307-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and any other creature as attackers.
When they are unblocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning the other attacking creature to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

15-803-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-803-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

776-3940-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
A creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
If the creature that entered the battlefield this turn has less than 4 power, some starting mana is required.
776-3940-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to the power of the highest power among creatures that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Cast Haze of Rage with its buyback cost by paying {3}{R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability and Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Haze of Rage's storm ability, copying it once for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage copies,, giving creatures you control +1/+0 per spell you've cast this turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

1090-3603-4344.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

985-1594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
